about: Answers of lossyWAV 1.4.2 to its own check (--check; exit 255 is the POSIX report of -1, 'already processed'), and of other runs, recorded by the lossywav fixtures workflow, run 42469204989 (artifact lossywav-fixtures-to-commit, manifest.json, 'probes'), so that the article's statements about the check do not rest on an artifact that expires. Each input is a WAV made from the music-44k-16-st signal; the hashes name the files probed.
